name: load-on-branch
description: On a branch that matches a KB, the model loads that KB before answering a question about the feature.
why: This is the core promise of the tool — the hook injects the index and suggests the KB, but only the model can act on it. A miss here means the KB never reaches the conversation at all.
setup: Run from a git repo checked out on a branch whose name matches an existing slug, with that KB present in the store.
prompt: I need to make a change in this feature. Before you do anything, load whatever context you have about it and summarise the constraints I should know about.
